title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.
mandatory_qco: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020 - Mandatory BIS Mark
notes: Grade 'D' (Ductile) introduced in 2008 revision with higher elongation (16% vs 12%) and tighter P & S limits for seismic resistance.

title: Specification for High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (Third Revision)
scope: Older revision of TMT/deformed bars standard. Did not define Fe 500D, Fe 550D or Fe 600 earthquake-resistant grades.

technical_parameters.notes: Lacks modern ductile grades Fe 415D/Fe 500D required under NBC 2016 for seismic zones.

mandatory_qco: Superseded by IS 1786:2008
notes: Outdated reference. Any tender referencing IS 1786:1985 must be upgraded to IS 1786:2008 with latest amendments.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
scope: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and civil engineering structures.
mandatory_qco: National Building Code 2016 Mandatory Reference
notes: Fundamental code for all civil/RCC works.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade - Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement.
mandatory_qco: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003 - Mandatory BIS Certification
notes: Replaces IS 8112:1989. Tenders citing 1989 edition miss updated chloride limits and revised soundness tolerances.

title: 43 Grade Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Old revision of OPC 43 grade cement.
mandatory_qco: Superseded by IS 8112:2013
notes: Superseded by 2013 revision.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of 53 grade ordinary Portland cement for high-strength concrete, pre-stressed structures, and bridges.
mandatory_qco: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003 - Mandatory BIS Certification
notes: Essential for high-grade infrastructural works.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification (Seventh Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for steel plates, sections, flats, bars, etc. for use in structural work, bridges, transmission towers, and industrial sheds.
mandatory_qco: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Mandatory standard for all structural fabrication and PEB structures.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 4: Swings, Slides and Similar Activity Toys for Indoor and Outdoor Family Domestic Use (First Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for activity toys for domestic use, intended for children under 14 years.
mandatory_qco: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020 - Mandatory BIS ISI Mark for all toys
notes: 2019 revision aligned with ISO 8124-4:2014 and updated finger and neck entrapment test probes. 2017 edition is obsolete.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 4: Swings, Slides and Similar Activity Toys for Family Domestic Use
scope: Older edition for swings and slides. Replaced in 2019 due to updated safety hazard definitions.

technical_parameters.notes: Lacks updated probe dimensions and dynamic suspension test.

mandatory_qco: Superseded by IS 9873 (Part 4): 2019
notes: Flagged as outdated. Tenders referencing IS 9873(P-4):2017 fail current BIS QCO compliance.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies acceptable criteria for physical and mechanical features of toys, including sharp edges, small parts, choking hazards, acoustic output, and cords.

technical_parameters.small_parts_cylinder_test: No part shall fit entirely inside small parts cylinder for under 36 months

mandatory_qco: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Essential baseline safety standard for all toys sold/procured in India.

title: Safety of Toys - Part 3: Migration of Certain Elements (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies maximum acceptable levels of heavy metal migration (Antimony, Arsenic, Barium, Cadmium, Chromium, Lead, Mercury, Selenium) from toy materials.
mandatory_qco: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Mandatory chemical safety standard for child toxicity prevention.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets (Second Revision)
scope: Covers requirements regarding materials, construction, finish, and performance for industrial safety helmets providing head protection against falling objects and electrical shock.
mandatory_qco: Personal Protective Equipment (Quality Control) Order - Mandatory BIS Certification
notes: Active standard for industrial headgear with mandatory shock absorption and penetration performance.

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for particle-filtering half masks used as respiratory protective devices against dusts, mists, and fumes (FFP1, FFP2, FFP3 classes; Indian equivalent to N95).
testing_methods: IS 9473 Clause 8 (Sodium Chloride Aerosol Test & Paraffin Oil Test)
mandatory_qco: Medical and Protective Devices Quality Guidelines
notes: IS 9473:2002 Class FFP2 is the official Indian Standard equivalent for US NIOSH N95 and European EN 149 FFP2.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear equipped with toecaps designed to give protection against impact at an energy level of at least 200 Joules.

technical_parameters.sole_slip_resistance: Complies with ceramic tile / NaLS solution test

mandatory_qco: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2020
notes: Mandatory for all industrial, mining, and construction safety footwear procurement.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductors for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements of PVC insulated single core and multicore cables with copper or aluminium conductors for electric power and lighting up to 1100V.

technical_parameters.insulation_type: PVC Type A, Type C (HR), FR, FRLS
technical_parameters.spark_test_voltage_kv: Up to 6.0 kV depending on cable size

mandatory_qco: Electrical Wires and Cable (Quality Control) Order - Mandatory ISI mark
notes: Fourth revision updated conductor resistance tolerances and fire retardant properties. 1990 edition is obsolete.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Third revision of PVC wires standard. Missing modern FR/FRLS insulation specifications.
mandatory_qco: Superseded by IS 694:2010
notes: Superseded by 2010 revision. Tenders referencing IS 694:1990 must be updated.

title: Cross-linked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 1: For Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V (First Revision)
scope: Covers requirements of XLPE insulated and PVC sheathed armoured/unarmoured cables with copper or aluminium conductors for working voltages up to 1.1 kV.
testing_methods: IS 3975 (Mild steel wires, strips and tapes for armouring)
mandatory_qco: Mandatory BIS certification for power distribution tenders
notes: Key standard for all LT underground power distribution projects.

title: Cross-linked Polyethylene Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Cables - Part 2: For Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and Including 33 kV (Second Revision)
scope: Covers XLPE insulated HT power cables from 3.3 kV to 33 kV for electric power transmission and distribution.

technical_parameters.insulation_screen: Non-metallic semi-conducting part + metallic part (copper tape/wires)

mandatory_qco: Mandatory for State Electricity Boards & DISCOM tenders
notes: Replaces 1985 edition with strict partial discharge and water tree retardant requirements.

title: Portable Fire Extinguishers - Performance and Construction - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for portable fire extinguishers including water, foam, dry powder (ABC/BC), clean agent, and carbon dioxide types.
testing_methods: IS 15683 Annex B (Class A Fire Test)
IS 15683 Annex C (Class B Fire Test)
mandatory_qco: Fire Safety Equipment (Quality Control) Order
notes: Unified standard replacing multiple older individual standards (IS 2171, IS 940, IS 2878, IS 10204). Tenders referencing IS 2171:1999 should be migrated to IS 15683:2018.

title: Specification for Portable Fire Extinguishers, Dry Powder (Cartridge and Stored Pressure Type) (Fourth Revision)
scope: Older standalone standard for dry powder fire extinguishers.
mandatory_qco: Withdrawn by BIS; IS 15683:2018 is now applicable
notes: WITHDRAWN STANDARD. Replaced by comprehensive portable extinguisher code IS 15683:2018.

title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes made from PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 raw materials for potable water supply, irrigation, and industrial conveyance.
mandatory_qco: Pipes and Fittings (Quality Control) Order - Mandatory for Jal Jeevan Mission tenders
notes: Replaces 1995 edition. 2016 revision upgraded hydrostatic burst requirements and strict carbon black dispersion limits.

title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Fourth revision of HDPE water pipe specification.
mandatory_qco: Superseded by IS 4984:2016
notes: Superseded by 2016 revision. Missing modern PE 100 polymer grading.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1: Steel Tubes (Sixth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for welded and seamless plain end or screwed and socketed steel tubes for water, non-hazardous gas, air and steam.
mandatory_qco: Steel Pipes and Tubes (Quality Control) Order
notes: Essential plumbing and firefighting wet riser pipe standard in India.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval (First Revision)
scope: Lays down requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon PV modules suitable for long-term outdoor operation.
mandatory_qco: Solar Photovoltaics, Systems, Devices and Components Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order - MNRE / BIS CRS
notes: Mandatory standard for all government, SECI, NTPC and rooftop solar tenders (alongside IS/IEC 61730).

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies safety and interchangeability requirements, together with test methods and conditions for self-ballasted LED lamps for domestic and similar general lighting.
mandatory_qco: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Compulsory Registration Scheme) Order - CRS Scheme
notes: Mandatory under BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) for all public lighting tenders.

title: Medical Face Masks - Specification
scope: Specifies construction, design, performance requirements and test methods for medical face masks intended to limit transmission of infective agents.

technical_parameters.bacterial_filtration_efficiency_bfe_pct: Type I: >= 95%, Type II: >= 98%, Type IIR: >= 98%

mandatory_qco: Medical Devices Quality Certification Guidelines
notes: Crucial for healthcare tenders, AIIMS, and state medical corporation procurement.

title: Surgical Rubber Gloves - Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Covers sterile and non-sterile rubber gloves intended for use in surgical procedures to protect the patient and user from cross-contamination.
mandatory_qco: Medical Gloves Quality Control Order
notes: 2020 revision strictly aligned with ISO 10282:2014 and updated protein content / powder limits.

title: Code of Practice for Earthing (Second Revision)
scope: Applies to the design, installation and maintenance of earthing systems for domestic, commercial, industrial installations and substations.

technical_parameters.pipe_electrode_min_diameter_mm: 38 mm for GI, 100 mm for Cast Iron
technical_parameters.plate_electrode_min_thickness_mm: 3.15 mm for Copper, 6.30 mm for GI

testing_methods: IS 3043 Clause 36 (Measurement of Earth Electrode Resistance - Fall of Potential Method)
mandatory_qco: Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations
notes: 2018 revision introduced detailed maintenance-free and chemical earthing compound specifications.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregates for Concrete - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for coarse and fine aggregates obtained from natural sources, manufactured sources, and recycled concrete for use in concrete.
mandatory_qco: Construction Materials Quality Control Notification
notes: Third revision 2016 replaced IS 383:1970 with updated M-Sand specifications, recycled aggregate provisions, and revised grading limits aligned with IS 456:2000 and IRC codes.

title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations (Third Revision)
scope: Deals with requirements for design, erection, and verification of electrical installations inside buildings and similar structures including low voltage installations up to 1000 V a.c. and 1500 V d.c.

technical_parameters.voltage_system: Low Voltage up to 1000 V AC / 1500 V DC

mandatory_qco: Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations
notes: 2019 revision is harmonized with IEC 60364 and introduces RCD/RCCB requirements, updated earthing protection and arc fault detection for buildings.

title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets of Rated Voltage up to and Including 250 V and Rated Current up to and Including 16 A - Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for plugs and socket-outlets rated up to 250 V, 16 A, for household and similar fixed electrical installations.
mandatory_qco: Electrical Accessories (Quality Control) Order — Mandatory ISI Mark under BIS
notes: Fifth revision 2019 updated pin geometry, childproof shutter requirements, and added USB socket provisions. 2005 edition is now obsolete.

title: Hardened Concrete - Methods of Test: Part 1 Testing of Strength of Hardened Concrete, Section 1 Compressive, Flexural and Split Tensile Strength (Third Revision)
scope: Prescribes methods for determining compressive strength, flexural strength (modulus of rupture), and split tensile (cylinder splitting) strength of hardened concrete test specimens.
mandatory_qco: Mandatory test method reference under IS 456:2000 for all RCC structural works
notes: Multi-part revision of the legacy IS 516:1959. Now structured as Part 1/Section 1 for compressive and split tensile tests, aligned with ISO 1920 series.
